scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @pickyourway/ai-services && npm run dev --workspace @pickyourway/server
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build --workspace @pickyourway/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace @pickyourway/ai-services && npm run build --workspace @pickyourway/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @pickyourway/ai-services && npm run typecheck --workspaces
